notes: All 10 runs (5 evals x with_skill/old_skill) completed and graded. Every run passed 100% of its assertions on both configurations — no functional regression detected from the reference-file split.

A factual inaccuracy was found in BOTH with_skill and old_skill answers for persist-locale-storage: the response claims StorageModule returns status_code 403 for a missing mobile.storage scope, but the SDK source only models 400/424/500/501 (plus 200/204) for StorageModule — 403 is never defined for it. Present in both configurations, so this predates the split and is not a regression introduced by this refactor.

A second, distinct factual inaccuracy was found in BOTH with_skill and old_skill answers for checkout-trigger-payment: the response fabricates error status codes (403/424/426) for CheckoutModule.triggerCheckout() that aren't part of its actual response type (TriggerCheckoutResponse only defines 400/500/501). Also present in both configurations — pre-existing, not a regression.

Several graders flagged the assertions themselves as weak/non-discriminating (presence-only checks that would pass even for subtly wrong implementations, e.g. wrong status codes) — worth tightening in a future eval iteration, not an action item for this MR.
